verdict.rationale: Linear documents Loops, recurring agent workflows that run on a schedule or in response to events, but nothing in the evidence shows versioning, reviewing changes to, or rolling back those loop definitions. The 'restore to any previous checkpoint from version history' line has no stated link to automations and cannot be credited. Author indicators showing text 'added by a loop' are an adjacent feature for reviewing loop output, not for versioning the automation itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
